input.description: Opus architectural review of layout code
input.prompt: The user explicitly asks for outside, Opus-level architectural judgment (dispatch mode 2: conversational review prose, not plan-file sections) on the design of the layout code in the repo at <project>. They have not yet committed to a design. Locate the layout code yourself (Grep/Glob), read it, and understand its intent and the project's stack and constraints before judging. Give a clear recommendation: the genuine design decision(s), your evaluated options, which you recommend and why, and the main risks. If you cannot find any layout code, or the target is ambiguous, say so plainly and name what would resolve it rather than guessing. Read-only; do not edit anything.
